component.name: Mind Elixir
component.summary: Lightweight desktop mind map and outliner, local-first with AI assistance

description.p: Mind Elixir is a lightweight desktop mind mapping and outlining application. It expands your creativity in just 10MB, keeps all data securely local, and enhances your thinking with AI while privacy remains in your hands.

ul.li: Mind map and outliner in one unified workspace
AI assistance with bring-your-own-model API keys
Local-first storage, with optional encrypted cloud sync
Import and export to common formats, images and PDF

screenshot.caption: Mind Elixir dashboard and mind map library
Mind mapping canvas and node editor

ul.li: Arabic Language & RTL Support: Added Arabic language support with full right-to-left layout, including mirrored navigation icons and localized search result messages
Markdown Import: Import mind maps directly from Markdown files or paste Markdown text from clipboard
Visual Polish: Fixed dialog and sheet overlay backgrounds appearing too opaque in light mode

description.p: Latest stable release with performance enhancements and bug fixes.
